markup.description: LeoTech transforms law enforcement data into actionable intelligence instantly – reducing weeks of manual investigation into seconds.

seen.name: LeoTech brings you 4 tools to create 1 unified intelligence and investigative solution Play play icon

A workforce multiplier for corrections LeoTech is built to solve the staffing crisis by reducing workload, not adding to it. By automating time-intensive processes and surfacing only what matters, the platform returns valuable hours back to staff, enabling them to focus on security, rehabilitation, and human interaction instead of manual data review.

Real ROI through operational efficiency This is not incremental improvement. It’s measurable impact. LeoTech reduces manual call review, automates inmate counts, and eliminates time spent switching between systems. The result is fewer labor hours required to operate the facility and more resources available for mission-critical responsibilities.

LeoTech AI Icon Earlier intervention for wellness and safety Risk develops before incidents occur. LeoTech identifies behavioral patterns, language indicators, and environmental signals that may point to mental health distress, suicide risk, or escalating behavior, giving staff the ability to intervene earlier and improve outcomes for both individuals and the facility.

LeoTech Network Icon All your data in one operational view Correctional facilities operate across disconnected systems that limit visibility. LeoTech unifies communications, video, and operational data into a single, real-time view—allowing staff and leadership to understand what is happening across the entire facility without switching between platforms.

LeoTech AI Search Icon Global search across every system Verus ION introduces true global search for corrections. Staff can instantly search across communications, video, reports, and operational systems from one interface, eliminating the need to manually gather information and accelerating decision-making in critical moments.

Automated operations that return time to staff Routine processes consume valuable staff time every day. With Verus Vision AI, functions like inmate count are automated using existing camera infrastructure, improving accuracy while returning hours back to officers to focus on higher-value responsibilities.

LeoTech AI Doc Icon Intelligence that understands behavior, not just keywords Traditional tools rely on keywords and manual filtering. LeoTech uses AI to understand context, relationships, and behavior surfacing the most relevant risks and insights without overwhelming users with unnecessary data.

LeoTech AI Bubble Icon Built for operators, not technologists Technology should work for the people using it. LeoTech is designed for correctional staff with intuitive workflows that require minimal training, enabling teams to generate value immediately without technical expertise.

Technology backed by real support Effective deployment requires more than software. LeoTech provides onboarding, ongoing support, and expert guidance to ensure agencies maximize the value of the platform and are prepared to respond when critical situations arise.

seen.name: Boca Raton, FL Field Technical Engineer The RoleYou will install, integrate and support our AI platform on site in corrections, law enforcement and government facilities. Most of the work is connecting camera fleets, video management systems (VMS) and facility networks to our analytics.

Remote Agentic Development Platform Engineer We're redesigning how software gets built. Our engineering organization has moved to cross-functional pods using spec-driven development with Claude Code and OpenSpec.

Remote DevOps Engineer We're hiring a DevOps / SRE to deploy, operate, and harden the AI systems that support corrections operations and intelligence analysis. Our data scientists build LLM-powered agents, RAG pipelines, and ontology-driven analytics — your job is to make sure those systems run reliably, securely, and auditably in environments where uptime, data segregation, and chain-of-custody actually matter.

Remote DevOps Manager As DevOps Manager, you will lead the team responsible for the cloud infrastructure, automation, and delivery pipelines behind our public safety platform. You will pair hands-on technical leadership with people management, growing a high-performing team while ensuring the platform meets the availability, security, and regulatory demands of the agencies we serve.

Boca Raton, FL AI Engineer As an AI/NLP Engineer on our Data Science team, you will be at the forefront of leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and cutting-edge AI techniques to create transformative solutions for public safety and intelligence workflows. You will apply your expertise in LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, Agentic AI, GraphRAG, and other advanced AI solutions to develop, enhance, and deploy robust features that enable real-time decision-making for our end users.
